name: cursor-local-models
description: For Cursor Private Inference: enrich provider models with catalog capabilities and translate model APIs through a loopback gateway.

cursorLocalModels.enabled.description: Run the loopback gateway for Cursor PI.

cursorLocalModels.upstream.description: Actual provider base URL, including /v1. All model requests and discovery go here; do not use this extension's loopback URL.

cursorLocalModels.port.description: Gateway port on 127.0.0.1. Set Cursor PI's Gateway base URL to http://127.0.0.1:<port>/v1.

cursorLocalModels.apiKeyEnv.description: Environment variable holding the provider key, used when no key is stored in SecretStorage.

commands.title: Cursor Local Models: Set API key
